7:25.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:28.web: one male goat for a sin offering;
7:28.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

7:29.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
7:29.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

7:30.kjv: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:

7:31.kjv: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:32.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

7:33.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

7:34.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

7:35.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.
7:35.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

7:36.kjv: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:

7:37.web: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;
7:37.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:39.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

7:40.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

7:41.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
7:41.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

7:42.web: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad
7:42.kjv: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, offered:

7:43.web: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;
7:43.kjv: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:44.web: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
7:44.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

7:45.web: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
7:45.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

7:46.web: one male goat for a sin offering;
7:46.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

7:47.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
7:47.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

7:48.web: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim
7:48.kjv: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, offered:

7:49.web: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;
7:49.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:50.web: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
7:50.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

7:51.web: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
7:51.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

7:52.web: one male goat for a sin offering;
7:52.kjv: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:

7:53.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.
7:53.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

7:54.web: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh
7:54.kjv: On the eighth day offered Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh:

7:55.web: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;
7:55.kjv: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:56.web: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
7:56.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

7:57.web: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
7:57.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

7:58.web: one male goat for a sin offering;
7:58.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

7:59.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
7:59.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

7:61.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:63.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

7:65.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.
7:65.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

7:67.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:71.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

7:73.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

7:77.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.

7:84.web: This was the dedication of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;
7:84.kjv: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

bsb: weighed a hundred and thirty shekels,
7:85.web: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary;
7:85.kjv: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

7:86.web: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;
7:86.kjv: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.

7:87.web: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and the male goats for a sin offering twelve;
7:87.kjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

7:88.web: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the male lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after it was anointed.
7:88.kjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

7:89.web: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spoke to him.
7:89.kjv: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

8:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

bsb: they are to light the area
8:2.web: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”
8:2.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

8:3.web: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
8:3.kjv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.

8:4.web: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work: according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses, so he made the lamp stand.
8:4.kjv: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

8:5.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

8:6.web: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
8:6.kjv: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

8:7.web: You shall do this to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
8:7.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

8:8.web: Then let them take a young bull, and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
8:8.kjv: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

8:9.web: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
8:9.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

8:10.web: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
8:10.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

8:11.web: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.
8:11.kjv: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.

8:12.web: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.
8:12.kjv: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.

bsb: You are to have the Levites
8:13.web: You shall set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.
8:13.kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.

bsb: In this way you shall separate
8:14.web: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
8:14.kjv: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

8:15.web: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting: and you shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.
8:15.kjv: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

8:16.web: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.
8:16.kjv: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

8:17.web: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.
8:17.kjv: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

8:18.web: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
8:18.kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

8:19.web: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”
8:19.kjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

8:20.web: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
8:20.kjv: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

8:21.web: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
8:21.kjv: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

8:22.web: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
8:22.kjv: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

8:23.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

8:24.web: “This is that which belongs to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;
8:24.kjv: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

8:25.web: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting on the work, and shall serve no more,
8:25.kjv: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:

8:26.web: but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. You shall do thus to the Levites concerning their duties.”
8:26.kjv: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

9:1.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
9:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

9:2.web: “Moreover let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.
9:2.kjv: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

9:3.web: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season—according to all its statutes, and according to all its ordinances, you shall keep it.”
9:3.kjv: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

9:4.web: Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should keep the Passover.
9:4.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

9:5.web: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.
9:5.kjv: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

9:6.web: There were certain men, who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day.
9:6.kjv: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

9:7.web: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”
9:7.kjv: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

9:8.web: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”
9:8.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.

9:9.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

9:10.web: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to Yahweh.
9:10.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.

bsb: They are to eat the lamb,
9:11.web: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
9:11.kjv: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

9:12.web: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.
9:12.kjv: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

9:13.web: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
9:13.kjv: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

9:14.web: “‘If a foreigner lives among you, and desires to keep the Passover to Yahweh; according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance, so shall he do. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner, and for him who is born in the land.’”
9:14.kjv: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

9:15.web: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony: and at evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
9:15.kjv: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

bsb: would cover the tabernacle by day,
9:16.web: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
9:16.kjv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

9:17.web: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.
9:17.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

9:18.web: At the commandment of Yahweh, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of Yahweh they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.
9:18.kjv: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

9:19.web: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept Yahweh’s command, and didn’t travel.
9:19.kjv: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.

9:20.web: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Yahweh they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Yahweh they traveled.
9:20.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.

9:21.web: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled: or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
9:21.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

9:22.web: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.
9:22.kjv: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

9:23.web: At the commandment of Yahweh they encamped, and at the commandment of Yahweh they traveled. They kept Yahweh’s command, at the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
9:23.kjv: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

10:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

10:2.web: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.
10:2.kjv: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

10:3.web: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
10:3.kjv: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

10:4.web: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
10:4.kjv: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

10:5.web: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.
10:5.kjv: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

10:6.web: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
10:6.kjv: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

bsb: you are to sound long blasts,
10:7.web: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
10:7.kjv: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

10:8.web: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.
10:8.kjv: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

10:9.web: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
10:9.kjv: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

10:10.web: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”
10:10.kjv: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.

10:11.web: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.
10:11.kjv: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

10:12.web: The children of Israel went forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.
10:12.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

10:13.web: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
10:13.kjv: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

10:14.web: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
10:14.kjv: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

10:15.web: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
10:15.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

10:16.web: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
10:16.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

bsb: and the Gershonites and the Merarites
10:17.web: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
10:17.kjv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

10:18.web: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
10:18.kjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

10:19.web: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
10:19.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

10:20.web: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.
10:20.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

10:21.web: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
10:21.kjv: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

10:22.web: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.
10:22.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

10:23.web: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.
10:23.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

10:24.web: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
10:24.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

10:25.web: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.
10:25.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

10:26.web: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.
10:26.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

10:27.web: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.
10:27.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

10:28.web: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.
10:28.kjv: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

bsb: and we will treat you well,
10:29.web: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”
10:29.kjv: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

10:30.web: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
10:30.kjv: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

10:31.web: He said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
10:31.kjv: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

10:32.web: It shall be, if you go with us, yes, it shall be, that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”
10:32.kjv: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

10:33.web: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
10:33.kjv: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.

10:34.web: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
10:34.kjv: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

10:35.web: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
10:35.kjv: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

bsb: And when it came to rest,
10:36.web: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
10:36.kjv: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.

bsb: of the LORD, and when He
11:1.web: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
11:1.kjv: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

11:2.web: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.
11:2.kjv: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.

11:3.web: The name of that place was called Taberah, because Yahweh’s fire burned among them.
11:3.kjv: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.

bsb: had a strong craving for other food,
11:4.web: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
11:4.kjv: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

11:5.web: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
11:5.kjv: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

11:6.web: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
11:6.kjv: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

bsb: and its appearance was like that
11:7.web: The manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like the appearance of bdellium.
11:7.kjv: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

11:8.web: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.
11:8.kjv: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

11:9.web: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
11:9.kjv: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

11:10.web: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.
11:10.kjv: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

11:11.web: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
11:11.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

11:12.web: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers?’
11:12.kjv: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

11:13.web: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
11:13.kjv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

11:14.web: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
11:14.kjv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

11:15.web: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
11:15.kjv: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

11:16.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.
11:16.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

11:17.web: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.
11:17.kjv: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

11:18.web: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.
11:18.kjv: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

11:19.web: You will not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,
11:19.kjv: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

11:20.web: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”
11:20.kjv: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

11:21.web: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’
11:21.kjv: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

11:22.web: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”
11:22.kjv: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

11:23.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
11:23.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD’S hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

11:24.web: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.
11:24.kjv: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

11:25.web: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
11:25.kjv: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

11:26.web: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested on them; and they were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
11:26.kjv: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

11:27.web: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
11:27.kjv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

11:28.web: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
11:28.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

11:29.web: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”
11:29.kjv: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD’S people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!

11:30.web: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
11:30.kjv: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

11:31.web: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.
11:31.kjv: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

11:32.web: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.
11:32.kjv: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

11:33.web: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, Yahweh’s anger burned against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.
11:33.kjv: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.

11:34.web: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
11:34.kjv: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

bsb: where they remained for some time.
11:35.web: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
11:35.kjv: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

12:1.web: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
12:1.kjv: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

12:2.web: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.
12:2.kjv: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.

12:3.web: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
12:3.kjv: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

12:4.web: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
12:4.kjv: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

12:5.web: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
12:5.kjv: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

12:6.web: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
12:6.kjv: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

12:7.web: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
12:7.kjv: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

12:8.web: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
12:8.kjv: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

12:9.web: Yahweh’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
12:9.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.

12:10.web: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
12:10.kjv: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

12:11.web: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
12:11.kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

12:12.web: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
12:12.kjv: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.

12:13.web: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
12:13.kjv: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

bsb: she may be brought back in.”
12:14.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”
12:14.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.

12:15.web: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
12:15.kjv: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

12:16.web: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
12:16.kjv: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

13:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

13:2.web: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
13:2.kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

13:3.web: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
13:3.kjv: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

13:4.web: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
13:4.kjv: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

13:5.web: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
13:5.kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

13:6.web: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
13:6.kjv: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

13:7.web: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
13:7.kjv: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

13:8.web: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
13:8.kjv: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

13:9.web: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
13:9.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

13:10.web: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
13:10.kjv: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

13:11.web: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
13:11.kjv: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

13:12.web: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
13:12.kjv: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

13:13.web: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
13:13.kjv: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

13:14.web: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
13:14.kjv: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

13:15.web: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
13:15.kjv: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

13:16.web: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
13:16.kjv: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

13:17.web: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
13:17.kjv: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

13:18.web: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
13:18.kjv: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

13:19.web: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
13:19.kjv: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

13:20.web: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
13:20.kjv: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

13:21.web: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
13:21.kjv: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

13:22.web: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
13:22.kjv: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

13:23.web: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
13:23.kjv: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

13:24.web: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
13:24.kjv: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

13:25.web: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
13:25.kjv: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

13:26.web: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
13:26.kjv: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

13:27.web: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
13:27.kjv: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

13:28.web: However the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
13:28.kjv: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

13:29.web: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
13:29.kjv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

13:30.web: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
13:30.kjv: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

13:31.web: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
13:31.kjv: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

13:32.web: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
13:32.kjv: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

13:33.web: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
13:33.kjv: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

14:1.web: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
14:1.kjv: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

14:2.web: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
14:2.kjv: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

14:3.web: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
14:3.kjv: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

14:4.web: They said to one another, “Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.”
14:4.kjv: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

14:5.web: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
14:5.kjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

bsb: among those who had spied out
14:6.web: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
14:6.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

14:7.web: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.
14:7.kjv: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

14:8.web: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us; a land which flows with milk and honey.
14:8.kjv: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

bsb: they will be like bread for us.
14:9.web: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”
14:9.kjv: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.

14:10.web: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.
14:10.kjv: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

14:11.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
14:11.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

14:12.web: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
14:12.kjv: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

14:13.web: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
14:13.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

14:14.web: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
14:14.kjv: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by daytime in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

14:15.web: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
14:15.kjv: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

14:16.web: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
14:16.kjv: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

14:17.web: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
14:17.kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

bsb: Yet He will by no means
14:18.web: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
14:18.kjv: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

14:19.web: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
14:19.kjv: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

14:20.web: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word:
14:20.kjv: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

bsb: and as surely as the whole
14:21.web: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory;
14:21.kjv: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.

14:22.web: because all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;
14:22.kjv: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

bsb: of those who have treated Me with contempt
14:23.web: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.
14:23.kjv: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

14:24.web: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.
14:24.kjv: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

14:25.web: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn, and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
14:25.kjv: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

14:26.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
14:26.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

14:27.web: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
14:27.kjv: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

14:28.web: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you.
14:28.kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

14:29.web: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against me,
14:29.kjv: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

14:30.web: surely you shall not come into the land, concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
14:30.kjv: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

bsb: But I will bring your children,
14:31.web: But your little ones, that you said should be captured or killed, them I will bring in, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.
14:31.kjv: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

14:32.web: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
14:32.kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

14:33.web: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
14:33.kjv: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

14:34.web: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
14:34.kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

14:35.web: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation, who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
14:35.kjv: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

14:36.web: The men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,
14:36.kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

14:37.web: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.
14:37.kjv: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.

14:38.web: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
14:38.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

14:39.web: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
14:39.kjv: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

14:40.web: They rose up early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised: for we have sinned.”
14:40.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.

14:41.web: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?
14:41.kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.

14:42.web: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.
14:42.kjv: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

14:43.web: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword, because you turned back from following Yahweh, therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”
14:43.kjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.

14:44.web: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
14:44.kjv: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

14:45.web: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down, even to Hormah.
14:45.kjv: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

15:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

15:2.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
15:2.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

15:3.web: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock;
15:3.kjv: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:

bsb: of a tenth of an ephah
15:4.web: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of oil.
15:4.kjv: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

15:5.web: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, the fourth part of a hin, with the burnt offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
15:5.kjv: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

15:6.web: “‘Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
15:6.kjv: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

15:7.web: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
15:7.kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

15:8.web: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh;
15:8.kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:

15:9.web: then shall he offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil:
15:9.kjv: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

15:10.web: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
15:10.kjv: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

15:11.web: Thus shall it be done for each bull, or for each ram, or for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
15:11.kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

15:12.web: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
15:12.kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

15:13.web: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
15:13.kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

bsb: And for the generations to come,
15:14.web: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; as you do, so he shall do.
15:14.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.

15:15.web: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so shall the foreigner be before Yahweh.
15:15.kjv: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.

15:16.web: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”
15:16.kjv: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

15:17.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

15:18.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,
15:18.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

15:19.web: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.
15:19.kjv: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.

15:20.web: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
15:20.kjv: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

15:21.web: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.
15:21.kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.

15:22.web: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments, which Yahweh has spoken to Moses,
15:22.kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
