23:13.web: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”
23:13.kjv: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

23:14.web: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
23:14.kjv: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

23:15.web: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
23:15.kjv: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.

23:16.web: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
23:16.kjv: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

23:17.web: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”
23:17.kjv: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?

23:18.web: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
23:18.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

bsb: that He should change His mind.
23:19.web: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?
23:19.kjv: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

bsb: a command to bless; He has blessed,
23:20.web: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
23:20.kjv: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

23:21.web: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
23:21.kjv: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.

23:22.web: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
23:22.kjv: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

23:23.web: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’
23:23.kjv: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

23:24.web: Behold, the people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”
23:24.kjv: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

23:25.web: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”
23:25.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

23:26.web: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’”
23:26.kjv: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?

23:27.web: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
23:27.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

23:28.web: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
23:28.kjv: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.

23:29.web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
23:29.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

23:30.web: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
23:30.kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

24:1.web: When Balaam saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to meet with enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
24:1.kjv: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

24:2.web: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
24:2.kjv: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

24:3.web: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
24:3.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

24:4.web: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
24:4.kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

24:5.web: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your tents, Israel!
24:5.kjv: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

24:6.web: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
24:6.kjv: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

24:7.web: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
24:7.kjv: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

24:8.web: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall eat up the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
24:8.kjv: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

bsb: Blessed are those who bless you
and cursed are those who curse you.”
24:9.web: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
24:9.kjv: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.

bsb: you have persisted in blessing them
24:10.web: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
24:10.kjv: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

24:11.web: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”
24:11.kjv: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.

24:12.web: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
24:12.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,

24:13.web: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?
24:13.kjv: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?

24:14.web: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”
24:14.kjv: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

24:15.web: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
24:15.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

24:16.web: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:
24:16.kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

24:17.web: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and break down all the sons of Sheth.
24:17.kjv: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

24:18.web: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemies, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
24:18.kjv: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.

24:19.web: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
24:19.kjv: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

24:20.web: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, But his latter end shall come to destruction.”
24:20.kjv: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.

24:21.web: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.
24:21.kjv: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

24:22.web: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
24:22.kjv: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

24:23.web: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
24:23.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

24:24.web: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
24:24.kjv: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.

24:25.web: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
24:25.kjv: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

25:1.web: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;
25:1.kjv: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.

25:2.web: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.
25:2.kjv: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

25:3.web: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor. Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.
25:3.kjv: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.

bsb: before the LORD, so that His
25:4.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”
25:4.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.

25:5.web: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”
25:5.kjv: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.

25:6.web: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
25:6.kjv: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

25:7.web: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.
25:7.kjv: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

25:8.web: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
25:8.kjv: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

25:9.web: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
25:9.kjv: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

25:10.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

25:11.web: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.
25:11.kjv: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

25:12.web: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.
25:12.kjv: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

25:13.web: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”
25:13.kjv: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.

25:14.web: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
25:14.kjv: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

25:15.web: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
25:15.kjv: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.

25:16.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

25:17.kjv: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

25:18.web: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”
25:18.kjv: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.

26:1.web: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
26:1.kjv: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

26:2.web: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”
26:2.kjv: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

26:3.web: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
26:3.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

bsb: Take a census of the men twenty
26:4.web: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward; as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those that came out of the land of Egypt.
26:4.kjv: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

26:5.web: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
26:5.kjv: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

26:6.web: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
26:6.kjv: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

26:7.web: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
26:7.kjv: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

26:8.kjv: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

26:9.web: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they rebelled against Yahweh,
26:9.kjv: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:

26:10.web: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
26:10.kjv: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

26:11.web: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
26:11.kjv: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

26:12.web: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
26:12.kjv: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

26:13.web: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
26:13.kjv: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

26:14.web: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
26:14.kjv: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

26:15.web: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
26:15.kjv: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

26:16.web: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
26:16.kjv: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

26:17.web: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
26:17.kjv: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

26:18.web: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
26:18.kjv: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

26:19.web: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
26:19.kjv: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

26:20.web: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
26:20.kjv: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

26:21.web: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
26:21.kjv: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

26:22.web: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
26:22.kjv: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

26:23.web: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
26:23.kjv: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

26:24.web: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
26:24.kjv: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

26:25.web: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
26:25.kjv: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

26:26.web: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
26:26.kjv: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

26:27.web: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.
26:27.kjv: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

26:28.web: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
26:28.kjv: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

26:29.web: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
26:29.kjv: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

26:30.web: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
26:30.kjv: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

26:31.web: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
26:31.kjv: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

26:32.web: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
26:32.kjv: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

26:33.web: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
26:33.kjv: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

26:34.web: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
26:34.kjv: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

26:35.web: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
26:35.kjv: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

26:36.web: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
26:36.kjv: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

26:37.web: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
26:37.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

26:38.web: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
26:38.kjv: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

26:39.web: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
26:39.kjv: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

26:40.web: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
26:40.kjv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

26:41.web: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
26:41.kjv: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

26:42.web: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
26:42.kjv: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

26:43.web: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
26:43.kjv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

26:44.web: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
26:44.kjv: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

26:45.web: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
26:45.kjv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

26:46.web: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
26:46.kjv: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.

26:47.web: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
26:47.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

26:48.web: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
26:48.kjv: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

26:49.web: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
26:49.kjv: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

26:50.web: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
26:50.kjv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

26:51.web: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
26:51.kjv: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

26:52.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

26:53.web: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
26:53.kjv: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

26:54.web: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
26:54.kjv: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

26:55.web: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
26:55.kjv: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

26:56.web: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
26:56.kjv: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

26:57.web: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
26:57.kjv: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

26:58.web: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
26:58.kjv: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

26:59.web: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
26:59.kjv: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

26:60.web: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
26:60.kjv: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

26:61.web: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.
26:61.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

26:62.web: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
26:62.kjv: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

26:63.web: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
26:63.kjv: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

26:64.web: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
26:64.kjv: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

26:65.web: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
26:65.kjv: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

27:1.web: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
27:1.kjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

27:2.web: They stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,
27:2.kjv: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

27:3.web: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.
27:3.kjv: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

27:4.web: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
27:4.kjv: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

27:5.web: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.
27:5.kjv: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

27:6.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

27:7.web: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
27:7.kjv: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

27:8.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
27:8.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

27:9.web: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
27:9.kjv: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

27:10.web: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
27:10.kjv: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.

bsb: that he may take possession of it.
27:11.web: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”
27:11.kjv: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.

27:12.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
27:12.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

27:13.web: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
27:13.kjv: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

27:14.web: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
27:14.kjv: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

27:15.kjv: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,

27:16.web: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
27:16.kjv: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

27:17.web: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”
27:17.kjv: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

27:18.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
27:18.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

27:19.web: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
27:19.kjv: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

27:20.web: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
27:20.kjv: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

27:21.web: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
27:21.kjv: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

27:22.web: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation.
27:22.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

27:23.web: He laid his hands on him, and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
27:23.kjv: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

28:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

28:2.web: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
28:2.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

28:3.web: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
28:3.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

28:4.web: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;
28:4.kjv: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

28:5.web: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
28:5.kjv: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

28:6.web: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
28:6.kjv: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

28:7.web: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.
28:7.kjv: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.

28:8.web: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
28:8.kjv: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

bsb: as well as a drink offering.
28:9.web: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
28:9.kjv: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

28:10.web: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
28:10.kjv: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

28:11.web: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
28:11.kjv: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

28:12.web: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
28:12.kjv: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

bsb: and a tenth of an ephah
28:13.web: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
28:13.kjv: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

bsb: to be made at each new moon
28:14.web: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
28:14.kjv: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

28:15.web: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
28:15.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

28:16.web: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.
28:16.kjv: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.

28:17.web: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
28:17.kjv: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

bsb: there is to be a sacred
28:18.web: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
28:18.kjv: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

28:19.web: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without defect;
28:19.kjv: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

28:20.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.
28:20.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

28:21.web: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
28:21.kjv: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

28:22.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
28:22.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

28:23.web: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
28:23.kjv: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

28:24.web: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
28:24.kjv: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

28:25.web: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
28:25.kjv: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

28:26.web: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
28:26.kjv: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

28:27.web: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;
28:27.kjv: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

28:28.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,
28:28.kjv: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

bsb: and a tenth of an ephah
28:29.web: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
28:29.kjv: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

28:30.web: one male goat, to make atonement for you.
28:30.kjv: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

28:31.web: Besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.
28:31.kjv: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

29:1.web: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
29:1.kjv: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.

29:2.web: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
29:2.kjv: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

29:3.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,
29:3.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,

bsb: and a tenth of an ephah
29:4.web: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
29:4.kjv: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

29:5.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
29:5.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:

29:6.web: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
29:6.kjv: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

29:7.web: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;
29:7.kjv: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:

29:8.web: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old; all without defect;
29:8.kjv: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:

29:9.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,
29:9.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,

bsb: and a tenth of an ephah
29:10.web: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs:
29:10.kjv: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

29:11.web: one male goat for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
29:11.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.

29:12.web: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.
29:12.kjv: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:

29:13.web: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; all without defect;
29:13.kjv: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:

29:14.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,
29:14.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,

bsb: and a tenth of an ephah
29:15.web: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
29:15.kjv: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:

29:16.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
29:16.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

29:17.web: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
29:17.kjv: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

bsb: along with the grain and drink offerings
29:18.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
29:18.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

29:19.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
29:19.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.

29:20.web: “‘On the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
29:20.kjv: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

bsb: along with the grain and drink offerings
29:21.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
29:21.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

29:22.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
29:22.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

29:23.web: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
29:23.kjv: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

bsb: along with the grain and drink offerings
29:24.web: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
29:24.kjv: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

29:25.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
29:25.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

29:26.web: “‘On the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
29:26.kjv: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

bsb: along with the grain and drink offerings
29:27.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
29:27.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

29:28.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
29:28.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

29:29.web: “‘On the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
29:29.kjv: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

bsb: along with the grain and drink offerings
29:30.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
29:30.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

29:31.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.
29:31.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

29:32.web: “‘On the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
29:32.kjv: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

bsb: along with the grain and drink offerings
29:33.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
29:33.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

29:34.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
29:34.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

29:35.web: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no regular work;
29:35.kjv: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:

29:36.web: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
29:36.kjv: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

bsb: along with the grain and drink offerings
29:37.web: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
29:37.kjv: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

29:38.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.
29:38.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

29:39.web: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”
29:39.kjv: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

29:40.web: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
29:40.kjv: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

30:1.web: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.
30:1.kjv: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.

30:2.web: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
30:2.kjv: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

30:3.web: “Also when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh, and binds herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
30:3.kjv: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth;

30:4.web: and her father hears her vow, and her bond with which she has bound her soul, and her father holds his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
30:4.kjv: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

30:5.web: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.
30:5.kjv: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

30:6.web: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul,
30:6.kjv: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;

30:7.web: and her husband hears it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
30:7.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

30:8.web: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he shall make void her vow which is on her, and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.
30:8.kjv: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.

30:9.web: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul, shall stand against her.
30:9.kjv: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

30:10.web: “If she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
30:10.kjv: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;

30:11.web: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and didn’t disallow her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she bound her soul shall stand.
30:11.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

30:12.web: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.
30:12.kjv: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.

30:13.web: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
30:13.kjv: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

30:14.web: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows, or all her bonds, which are on her. He has established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
30:14.kjv: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

30:15.web: But if he shall make them null and void after that he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
30:15.kjv: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.

30:16.web: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
30:16.kjv: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father’s house.

31:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

31:2.web: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
31:2.kjv: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

31:3.web: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.
31:3.kjv: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.

31:4.web: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”
31:4.kjv: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

31:5.web: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
31:5.kjv: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

31:6.web: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
31:6.kjv: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

31:7.web: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.
31:7.kjv: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

31:8.web: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
31:8.kjv: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

31:9.web: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
31:9.kjv: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

31:10.web: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
31:10.kjv: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

31:11.web: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
31:11.kjv: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

31:12.web: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
31:12.kjv: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

31:13.web: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
31:13.kjv: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

31:14.web: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
31:14.kjv: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.

31:15.web: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
31:15.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

31:16.web: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.
31:16.kjv: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.

31:17.web: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
31:17.kjv: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

31:18.web: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
31:18.kjv: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

31:19.web: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
31:19.kjv: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

31:20.web: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”
31:20.kjv: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.

31:21.web: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:
31:21.kjv: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;

31:22.web: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
31:22.kjv: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

31:23.web: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
31:23.kjv: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

31:24.web: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
31:24.kjv: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

31:25.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

31:26.web: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
31:26.kjv: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

31:27.web: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
31:27.kjv: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

31:28.web: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
31:28.kjv: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:

31:29.web: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.
31:29.kjv: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.

31:30.web: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”
31:30.kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.

31:31.web: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
31:31.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

31:32.web: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
31:32.kjv: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

31:33.web: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
31:33.kjv: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,

31:34.kjv: And threescore and one thousand asses,

31:35.web: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
31:35.kjv: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.

31:36.web: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:
31:36.kjv: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

31:37.web: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
31:37.kjv: And the LORD’S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

31:38.web: The cattle were thirty-six thousand; of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.
31:38.kjv: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD’S tribute was threescore and twelve.

31:39.web: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.
31:39.kjv: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD’S tribute was threescore and one.

31:40.web: The persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
31:40.kjv: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD’S tribute was thirty and two persons.

31:41.web: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
31:41.kjv: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

31:42.web: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
31:42.kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

31:43.web: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
31:43.kjv: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

31:44.web: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
31:44.kjv: And thirty and six thousand beeves,

31:45.web: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
31:45.kjv: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

31:47.web: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
31:47.kjv: Even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

31:48.web: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
31:48.kjv: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

31:49.web: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
31:49.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

31:50.web: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”
31:50.kjv: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.

31:51.web: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
31:51.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
