31:52.web: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
31:52.kjv: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

31:53.web: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
31:53.kjv: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

31:54.web: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.
31:54.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

32:1.web: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. When they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for livestock;
32:1.kjv: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

32:2.web: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
32:2.kjv: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

32:3.web: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
32:3.kjv: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

32:4.web: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
32:4.kjv: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

32:5.web: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
32:5.kjv: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

32:6.web: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to the war, and shall you sit here?
32:6.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

32:7.web: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?
32:7.kjv: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?

32:8.web: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
32:8.kjv: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

bsb: For when your fathers went up
32:9.web: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.
32:9.kjv: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

32:10.web: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
32:10.kjv: And the LORD’S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

32:11.web: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
32:11.kjv: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

32:12.web: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have followed Yahweh completely.’
32:12.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

32:13.web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight, was consumed.
32:13.kjv: And the LORD’S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.

32:14.web: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.
32:14.kjv: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

bsb: and you will be the cause of their destruction.”
32:15.web: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
32:15.kjv: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

bsb: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached
32:16.web: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
32:16.kjv: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

32:17.web: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
32:17.kjv: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

32:18.web: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have each inherited their inheritance.
32:18.kjv: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

32:19.web: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
32:19.kjv: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

32:20.web: Moses said to them, “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,
32:20.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,

32:21.web: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh, until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
32:21.kjv: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

32:22.web: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless towards Yahweh, and towards Israel; and this land shall be to you for a possession before Yahweh.
32:22.kjv: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

32:23.web: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.
32:23.kjv: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.

32:24.web: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
32:24.kjv: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

32:25.web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
32:25.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

32:26.web: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
32:26.kjv: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

32:27.web: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”
32:27.kjv: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.

32:28.web: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
32:28.kjv: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

32:29.web: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle, before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
32:29.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

bsb: then they must accept their possession
32:30.web: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
32:30.kjv: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

32:31.web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.
32:31.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

32:32.web: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
32:32.kjv: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.

32:33.web: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
32:33.kjv: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

32:34.web: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
32:34.kjv: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

32:35.kjv: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

32:36.web: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
32:36.kjv: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

32:37.web: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
32:37.kjv: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

32:38.web: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
32:38.kjv: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

32:39.web: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
32:39.kjv: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.

32:40.web: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
32:40.kjv: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

32:41.web: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
32:41.kjv: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.

32:42.web: Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
32:42.kjv: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

33:1.web: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
33:1.kjv: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

33:2.web: Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their goings out.
33:2.kjv: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

33:3.web: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
33:3.kjv: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

33:4.web: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.
33:4.kjv: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.

33:5.web: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
33:5.kjv: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

33:6.web: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
33:6.kjv: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

33:7.web: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.
33:7.kjv: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

33:8.web: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
33:8.kjv: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

33:9.web: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there.
33:9.kjv: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

33:10.web: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
33:10.kjv: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

33:11.web: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
33:11.kjv: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

33:12.web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
33:12.kjv: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

33:13.web: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
33:13.kjv: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

33:14.web: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
33:14.kjv: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

33:15.web: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
33:15.kjv: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

33:16.web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
33:16.kjv: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

33:17.web: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
33:17.kjv: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

33:18.web: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
33:18.kjv: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

33:19.web: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
33:19.kjv: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.

33:20.web: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
33:20.kjv: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.

33:21.web: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
33:21.kjv: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

33:22.web: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
33:22.kjv: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

33:23.web: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
33:23.kjv: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

33:24.web: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
33:24.kjv: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

33:25.web: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
33:25.kjv: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

33:26.web: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
33:26.kjv: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

33:27.web: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
33:27.kjv: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

33:28.web: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
33:28.kjv: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

33:29.web: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
33:29.kjv: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

33:30.web: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
33:30.kjv: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

33:31.web: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
33:31.kjv: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.

33:32.web: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
33:32.kjv: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

33:33.web: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
33:33.kjv: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

33:34.web: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
33:34.kjv: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

33:35.web: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
33:35.kjv: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.

33:36.web: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
33:36.kjv: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

33:37.web: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
33:37.kjv: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

33:38.web: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
33:38.kjv: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.

33:39.web: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
33:39.kjv: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

33:40.web: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
33:40.kjv: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

33:41.web: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
33:41.kjv: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.

33:42.web: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
33:42.kjv: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

33:43.web: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
33:43.kjv: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.

33:44.web: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
33:44.kjv: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.

33:45.web: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
33:45.kjv: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.

33:46.web: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
33:46.kjv: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.

33:47.web: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
33:47.kjv: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

33:48.web: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
33:48.kjv: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

33:49.web: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
33:49.kjv: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

33:50.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
33:50.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

33:51.web: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
33:51.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

33:52.web: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
33:52.kjv: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

bsb: You are to take possession of
33:53.web: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
33:53.kjv: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

33:54.web: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
33:54.kjv: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

33:55.web: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides, and they will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
33:55.kjv: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

33:56.web: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so will I do to you.”
33:56.kjv: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

34:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

34:2.web: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
34:2.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

34:3.web: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
34:3.kjv: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

34:4.web: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
34:4.kjv: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:

34:5.web: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
34:5.kjv: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

34:6.web: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
34:6.kjv: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

34:7.web: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
34:7.kjv: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

34:8.web: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
34:8.kjv: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

34:9.web: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
34:9.kjv: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

34:10.web: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
34:10.kjv: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:

34:11.web: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
34:11.kjv: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

34:12.web: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
34:12.kjv: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

34:13.web: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
34:13.kjv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

34:14.web: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance.
34:14.kjv: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

34:15.web: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
34:15.kjv: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

34:16.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

34:17.web: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
34:17.kjv: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

34:18.web: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
34:18.kjv: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

34:19.web: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
34:19.kjv: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

34:20.web: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
34:20.kjv: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

34:21.web: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
34:21.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

34:22.web: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
34:22.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

34:23.web: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
34:23.kjv: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

34:24.web: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
34:24.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

34:25.web: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
34:25.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

34:26.web: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
34:26.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

34:27.web: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
34:27.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

34:28.web: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
34:28.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

34:29.web: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
34:29.kjv: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

35:1.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
35:1.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

35:2.web: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in. You shall give suburbs for the cities around them to the Levites.
35:2.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

35:3.web: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their suburbs shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.
35:3.kjv: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

35:4.web: “The suburbs of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.
35:4.kjv: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

35:5.web: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the suburbs of their cities.
35:5.kjv: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

35:6.web: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.
35:6.kjv: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

35:7.web: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their suburbs.
35:7.kjv: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

35:8.web: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many; and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”
35:8.kjv: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

35:9.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

35:10.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
35:10.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

35:11.web: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
35:11.kjv: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

35:12.web: The cities shall be to you for refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die, until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
35:12.kjv: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

35:13.web: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
35:13.kjv: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

35:14.web: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.
35:14.kjv: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

35:15.web: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the foreigner living among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
35:15.kjv: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

bsb: must surely be put to death.
35:16.web: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
35:16.kjv: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

bsb: he is a murderer; the murderer
must surely be put to death.
35:17.web: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
35:17.kjv: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

bsb: he is a murderer; the murderer
must surely be put to death.
35:18.web: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
35:18.kjv: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

35:19.web: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.
35:19.kjv: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

35:20.web: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,
35:20.kjv: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

bsb: must surely be put to death;
35:21.web: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meets him.
35:21.kjv: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

35:22.web: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,
35:22.kjv: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

35:23.web: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;
35:23.kjv: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

35:24.web: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
35:24.kjv: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

35:25.web: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
35:25.kjv: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

35:26.web: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, where he flees,
35:26.kjv: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

35:27.web: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,
35:27.kjv: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

35:28.web: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
35:28.kjv: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

35:29.web: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
35:29.kjv: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

bsb: the murderer is to be put to death
is to be put to death
35:30.web: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.
35:30.kjv: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

bsb: to die; he must surely be put to death.
35:31.web: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.
35:31.kjv: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

35:32.web: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
35:32.kjv: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

bsb: of the one who shed it.
35:33.web: “‘So you shall not pollute the land in which you are; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.
35:33.kjv: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

35:34.web: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, in the middle of which I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell in the middle of the children of Israel.’”
35:34.kjv: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

36:1.web: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.
36:1.kjv: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

36:2.web: They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
36:2.kjv: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

36:3.web: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
36:3.kjv: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

36:4.web: When the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
36:4.kjv: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

36:5.web: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks right.
36:5.kjv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

36:6.web: This is the thing which Yahweh does command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best; only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.
36:6.kjv: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

36:7.web: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
36:7.kjv: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

36:8.web: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.
36:8.kjv: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

36:9.web: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”
36:9.kjv: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

36:10.web: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:
36:10.kjv: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

36:11.web: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
36:11.kjv: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:

36:12.web: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
36:12.kjv: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

36:13.web: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
36:13.kjv: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
